o: 21 new Castaways are set to embark on the adventure of a lifetime. Stranded on the beaches of Fiji they’re tasked with forming a new society, adapting to their surroundings, and navigating an unpredictable social game to ensure their torch stays lit. The Open Era will test their endurance, strategy, and willpower in pursuit of the title of Sole Survivor and the $1 million grand prize.

eps.o: Castaways marooned in remote Fiji embark upon the Open Era of Survivor and battle to win $1 million. The catchphrase of the season, "permanent uncertainty," comes into play as soon as the castaways reach the beach and discover that one player must leave to go on a mysterious journey. Then, the first tribal council pits two allies against each other in a dramatic battle of wills.

A chilling injury at camp threatens to send one player home. Two tribes face off in a daunting immunity challenge at sea where one tribe struggles to keep afloat. Then, tribal council takes a wild turn when one player attempts a never-before-seen move to save an ally.

n the wake of a rocky tribal council, a castaway makes a shocking move. A mysterious Tree Mail delivers a game-changing twist. Then, two castaways secretly bond at tribal council in an attempt to change the course of the vote.
